notes.urn:cts:greekLit:tlg0533.tlg003.perseus-: The first two lines close the preceding epigram; 'the twenty' presumably refers to days, between the dates given in its opening lines. 'Skill' renders sophia, which can also mean wisdom or poetic art.

nodes.text: the ox came under the plough of its own accord. Well done, my Hermes,
well done, mine! I do not complain about the twenty [days].
What a good charm Polyphemus discovered
for the lover! By Earth, the Cyclops was no fool.
truly, skill is the all-healing remedy for everything.
Hunger too, I think, has this one thing, set against its evils,
as its good: it cuts out the sickness of loving boys.
